market.question: Will the highest temperature in Miami be between 90-91°F on May 8?

assessment.reasoning: Miami NWS forecast for May 8 calls for highs in the lower 90s. The 90-91°F bucket captures the lower half of 'lower 90s' (90-93). Roughly 30-40% probability the high lands specifically in 90-91°F vs 92-93°F or upper 80s.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Coastal sea breeze and any cloud cover can shift airport reading 1-2°F.
